summary: Iteration 6 validates the additive V1.5 §22 + §23 layer — Workout Intelligence (exercise video store + video-suggestion fallback chain) and Weekly Coach Video Script Generator (Claude Sonnet 4.5 personalisation) plus adaptive check-in AI questions. 22 new tests added in /app/backend/tests/test_scripts_video.py. Full suite (regression + new): 85/85 PASS in 238s on preview URL (Claude-heavy endpoints use localhost:8001 due to Cloudflare's ~60s edge timeout — noted in iter_5 already). No functional bugs found. All 9 features listed in the review request validated end-to-end including edit_history append, approved→sent_at + non-blocking push, coach→youtube→search fallback chain, style default/invalid handling, and background script kickoff (verified within 60s poll window).
action_items: None blocking. Feature is complete; all 85 tests green.

OPTIONAL / LOW (repeat from iter_5): server.py is now 1795 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (events/, workouts/, coach/scripts/, exercises/, checkins/, roster/, hotels/, nutrition/, messages/). Coach Weekly Script generator + Adaptive Check-in are natural first extractions.

OPTIONAL / LOW: SCRIPT_SYSTEM prompt asks the LLM for push_text ≤80 chars but the review spec allows ≤120. Current outputs comply with ≤80 and pass the ≤120 assertion. If the coach ever wants longer push copy, relax the prompt to match.

OPTIONAL / LOW: PATCH /coach/scripts/{id} appends to edit_history only when the 'script' field itself changes (server.py:1474). Edits to summary_bullets / whatsapp / push_text are NOT recorded in history. Consider tracking those too for coach 'learning input' analytics.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /exercises/{id}/video (server.py:1253-1271): coach-only guard correct; is_coach_video=true sets coach_video_url unconditionally; is_coach_video=false ONLY writes video_url if no coach_video_url already exists (server.py:1266). This prevents a YouTube link from silently overriding a coach video — validated by dedicated regression test.

GET /exercises/{id}/video-suggestion (server.py:1274-1291): correct priority coach → yt → search-URL fallback. Fallback uses PREFERRED_CHANNELS[0]='Jeff Nippard' and builds a channel-scoped YouTube search URL. All three branches asserted.

POST /checkins/questions (server.py:1306-1340): safe default fallback with 6 questions (1 required 'recovery' scale, 3 more scales, 2 text) is returned when LLM fails. Non-empty questions list guaranteed by design. Verified.

POST /checkins/adaptive (server.py:1343-1360): correctly persists check-in with answers dict, then fires script generation as asyncio.create_task (fire-and-forget). Endpoint returned in <2s during test even though Claude call is 15-25s — kickoff is truly async. New coach_scripts row appeared within 60s poll window. Verified.

_generate_script_for (server.py:1385-1443): correct style resolution — override → profile.style → 'friendly'; invalid style is normalized to 'friendly' via `if style not in COACH_STYLES: style = 'friendly'`. Validated with override='made_up_style_xyz' returning style='friendly'.

Script generator payload (server.py:1404-1414) correctly gathers profile+event(with phase_info)+last_checkin+recent_workouts (completed/missed titles)+upcoming_days for personalisation. Recent workouts limited to 20; titles limited to 5 each; roster days limited to 7 — good token budgeting.

PATCH /coach/scripts/{id} (server.py:1467-1490): edit_history is a list of {at, prev, new} appended only on script field change, capped at last 10 (server.py:1476) — good bounded growth. approved=true triggers send_push wrapped in try/except so a push failure never blocks the coach's edit. sent_at is written idempotently (only if not already set — server.py:1477). Verified.

GET /coach/scripts (server.py:1451-1456): scoped to coach_id + optional client_id filter, DESC sort on created_at, projection strips _id. GET /coach/scripts/{id} (server.py:1459-1464) matches on both id AND coach_id → 404 for wrong coach (validated).
PATCH /auth/coach-style (server.py:1493-1498): validates style against COACH_STYLES list (400 on mismatch), persists to profile.style, coach-only via require_role. All 7 styles round-tripped.
MongoDB _id stripped consistently via {'_id': 0} projections and clean_doc() — good. No _id leakage observed in any response.
